idea: How to save water at home
title: How to Find Silent Water Leaks in Your Home
description: Silent toilet leaks are one of the most common causes of high water bills in residential homes. A worn flapper or misaligned flush valve can waste hundreds of gallons of water each day without making a sound. To check your toilet, remove the tank lid and place a few drops of food coloring into the water inside the tank. Wait 15 minutes without flushing. If the colored water seeps down into the toilet bowl, your flapper valve is leaking and needs replacement. Replacing a degraded rubber flapper is a simple fix that instantly conserves water and lowers your utility bill.
